# JS CodeLab
JS CodeLab is a free online JavaScript compiler and playground. It allows developers to write, run, test, and learn JavaScript directly in their browser without requiring any installation or user accounts.

It features a professional-grade editor powered by Monaco, secure local execution using Web Workers, and offline project storage using IndexedDB. All code remains strictly on the user's device.

## Key Resources
- **Home**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/
- **Playground**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/playground
- **Examples**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/examples
- **Learn Guides**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn
- **About**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/about
- **Privacy Policy**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/privacy
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/sureshkumar9651/compiler

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router)
- **Editor**: Monaco Editor (@monaco-editor/react)
- **Execution**: Client-side Web Workers
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Data Storage**: IndexedDB (idb package)
